description: This file defines a Kotlin class ConnectionLiveData that extends LiveData to observe and emit updates about the device's network connectivity status. It uses Android's ConnectivityManager and NetworkCallback to monitor network changes and reports different connection types such as WiFi, Ethernet, Mobile Data, or Lost.

classes.name: ConnectionLiveData
classes.description: A LiveData subclass that provides real-time updates on the device's network connection status, notifying observers whenever there is a change in network connectivity or type.

classes.name: ConnectionType
classes.description: Enumeration representing various types of network connections such as WiFi, Ethernet, Mobile Data, Other, or Lost.

methods.name: <init>
methods.description: Constructor initializes network callback registration to monitor network status changes.
